rationale: Both candidates correctly address the one substantive ground-truth point (the already_submitted-gated unwrap is fine because StagePool rejects lists on both submit_initial and submit_update); Y's reasoning on this matches the human reviewer's rationale almost verbatim with concrete line evidence, while X covers it more generically. X's review is dominated by an elaborate 'Blocker' claim that ZImagePipeline.forward() is fundamentally broken (dropped kwargs, runtime TypeError, cascading _ZPipelineSamplingParams/prompt_embeds failures) — this is a dramatic, specific claim that directly contradicts the actual outcome (two real maintainers gave unqualified LGTM approvals with no mention of a call-breaking regression), strongly suggesting it is fabricated/hallucinated and severely hurting X's precision since it anchors the whole verdict. Y stays grounded in verifiable diff-adjacent evidence, gives a COMMENT (non-blocking) verdict consistent with the real outcome, and offers concrete actionable follow-ups (a test stub, CI-gate sanity check) without overreaching claims.
